name: marnies_grimmsnarl_ex_v5
policy: v4 route/target model + two TCG-fundamentals fixes: (1) generalized damage-immune-wall (Crustle/Sylveon/Neutralization Zone) handling that stops hammering a 0-damage Shadow Bullet, un-suppresses development while walled, and values a Boss's Orders unlock; (2) evolve-on-the-bench rules so Morgrem is only evolved into the Active when it can attack this turn and Grimmsnarl ex is built on the bench rather than fed into a wall it cannot damage.
validation_scope: syntax, 60-card deck, self-contained runtime, 34 static golden-state tests (22 inherited v4 + 12 new v5); replay smoke test over 4 Crustle-wall episodes (388 grimmsnarl decisions, 0 exceptions, 0 policy fallbacks); v4-vs-v5 divergence audit on identical observations confirms the wall is no longer hammered and evolutions move to the bench. Live win-rate must be measured by the user on the competition engine.
description: Pokemon-TCG-fundamentals pass over v4: damage-immune-wall unlocking and safe evolution placement, grounded in the 658.1-rating ladder log.
